title: What the Storyworth Book Is Actually Like
summary: A hardcover, printed in their own words, with photos beside the stories. What the finished Storyworth book is like, and what comes with it.
body_markdown:
They spend a year sharing stories and then the big moment: their book arrives! What it looks like, are the materials high quality, and will your mother feel proud to have it on her shelf are important to know before committing to Storyworth.


## **It's a real hardcover book**


Not a flimsy paperback, no spiral binding, and not a stack of printouts. It is a 6x9 hardcover book with a custom cover featuring a title and photo chosen by you. We use archival quality materials to ensure it will look beautiful for generations to come.


Reknown book designer, Carol Ly, completely redesigned the layouts in 2025 creating a look that's modern but timeless. The result is a book that will look right at home in bookstore with other best sellers.


## **Photographs sit with the story they belong to**


Your storyteller can add photos through the year, by attaching them to an email reply or adding them into each story on the Storyworth site. Photos resize and snap into place automatically and you can easily add captions. They print alongside the stories they go with instead of being gathered into a section at the back.


A photograph of the house someone grew up in, printed next to their description of it, does something that neither manages alone.


## **The book is not the only thing that arrives**


Every plan includes two more versions of the finished memoir at no extra cost on every Storyworth plan: an e-book and audiobook version that can be shared with the entire family.


If your storyteller answered any questions over the phone with a Story Call, Magic Interview or Family Call their recordings stay available by scanning a QR code in the book, so you'll always be able to hear their stories in their words forever.


## **Most families end up ordering more than one**


At least one book copy comes with every plan but you can order more at any time - even after your plan year has ended. One copy of a memoir by a grandmother with four children and eight grandchildren likely won't b enough, because once the first one arrives everybody will want their own.


## **There's no rush to finish their book**


Creating a memoir is an important project. While questions come every week for a year, it often takes longer to finish and be ready to print. That's totally fine! It's their story to tell in their way.


Even after the plan year has ended a storyteller can answer any questions that have already come, edit existing stories, add photos and change the cover image. You'll never loose access to your account and stories are privately owned by you forever.


## **If you are weighing up other services**


Most guided memoir services end in a printed book, and the books differ far more than the websites suggest. Remento, Memorygram, StoryTerrace, Storii, My Life in a Book, Meminto, MyStories and Memowrite each make their own choices about format and finish.


Three things are worth looking at before you commit a year to filling one. Whether it is hardcover and who designed the layout. If QR codes link to voice recordings, you'll wan to feel confident that the company is stable and will stay in business so they'll continue to work. What a second copy costs, including whether you can still order one in five years.


## What to look at if you are comparing services


Most guided memoir services end in a printed book, and the books differ more than the websites suggest. Remento, Memorygram, StoryTerrace, Storii, My Life in a Book, Meminto, MyStories and Memowrite each make their own choices about format and finish.


Three questions separate them quickly:


1. **Is it hardcover, and who designed the layout?** Did they take care to make sure the printed book reflects the importance of the stories inside?
2. **Can you hear their voice in addition to reading their stories?** Is an audiobook included and will QR codes continue to work a decade from now?
3. **What does an extra copy cost, and can you add or edit?** In five years you may find new pictures you want to add or remember details of a story. You should be able to add them and print new copies.


The finished book should be designed to be cherished by family now, and passed down for generations so it's worth knowing what it is before you commit a year to filling it.
